name: digests
description: Scheduled digests you define: pick sources (feeds, recent mail, endpoints), write the synthesis prompt, get the result stored, pushed, or both. Morning briefings, news, repo roundups — one engine.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 010_digests.sql, hot-loads the app).

Create a digest: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/digests/digests -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "morning-brief", "prompt": "Summarise into a short morning briefing.", "interval_min": 1440}'
Add sources: POST /api/digests/digests/{id}/sources with {"kind": "feed", "ref": "https://.../feed.xml"} (kinds: feed, emails, endpoint).
Delivery upgrades automatically: with the ntfy package the digest is pushed to your phone; with the LLM gateway it is synthesized (without it, raw material is stored).
